info.name: AixBOMS data stack - Phase 1
info.description:
Tests for the Phase 1 demo: views, GraphQL, CRUD, relationships, business rules and error codes.

Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner, or `newman run`): requests save the ids that later requests use, and every request has tests. Each run uses its own names and serial numbers and cleans up after itself.

Set `baseUrl` if the app does not run on http://localhost:8080.

item.name: 1 Views
item.description: The UI's rack list: a stored GraphQL query served as plain REST.

exec: // New suffix for every run, so names and serial numbers never clash with earlier runs
pm.test("racks carry children and administrators", () => page.items.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.children).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(r.administrators).to.be.an("array"); }));

request.description: `name` is an SQL LIKE pattern; `%` is sent as `%25`.

item.name: 2 GraphQL
item.description: The schema behind the views, queried directly on POST /graphql. GraphiQL: {{baseUrl}}/graphiql

item.name: Only the fields you ask for

request.description: The response has exactly the shape of the query. Children and administrators are not even fetched.
Validation against the schema happens before any code runs; GraphQL reports it in `errors`.

item.name: 3 Persons
item.description: CRUD on persons. `contact` is a JSON attribute (jsonb column): humans and AI agents fill different fields.

request.description: Fields left out stay unchanged. `version` must be the one you read.

item.name: 4 Racks and components
item.description: CRUD on racks and components. A Rack is a Component (single-table inheritance).

exec: pm.test("racks are components too", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(c => c.type)).to.include("RACK"));

item.name: 5 Rack children (1-to-N)
item.description: Putting components into racks and taking them out. Includes the NoContainmentCycle rule.

item.name: Put rack B into rack A
Put rack A into rack B → 422 (rule NoContainmentCycle)

request.description: A -> B -> A would be a cycle.

item.name: Take out a component that is not there → 404
Delete a rack that has children → 409
6 Rack administrators (M-to-N)
item.description: Administrators with the primaryAdministrator flag. Includes the SinglePrimaryAdministrator rule.

item.name: Add agent as primary (demotes the human)
List: agent is primary, human is not

exec: const links = pm.response.json(); const byId = id => links.find(l => l.person.id === pm.collectionVariables.get(id));
const links = pm.response.json(); const byId = id => links.find(l => l.person.id === pm.collectionVariables.get(id));

item.name: View shows rack A with its administrators

exec: pm.test("rack B is a child", () => pm.expect(rack.children.map(c => c.type)).to.include("RACK"));
pm.test("human is primary in the view", () => pm.expect(rack.administrators.find(a => a.primaryAdministrator).person.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("personId")));

item.name: 7 Cleanup
item.description: Removes everything this run created, through the API.

item.name: Take component out of rack B
Take rack B out of rack A
Delete rack A (its administrator links go with it)
